title: Bounded GetAttributeList analogue on SendRRData with optional CPF items
purpose: Exercise the documented RegisterSession to SendRRData unconnected explicit-message path and CPF item assembly around a safe, bounded GetAttributeList-shaped request with optional sockaddr items, while avoiding the historical repeated-attribute high-count payload.

messages.label: SendRRData bounded GetAttributeList analogue with optional sockaddr CPF items

expected_behavior: Server should parse a complete RegisterSession and then process SendRRData through CPF decoding. Depending on implementation support and object model, it may return success, a normal CIP error, or an encapsulation-level error, but it should not corrupt outer metadata or crash.
constraints_preserved: SendRRData command 0x006F with little-endian payload length
CPF includes Null Address Item 0x0000 and Unconnected Data Item 0x00B2
Optional CPF items use issue-described sockaddr item positions as bounded zero-length structural analogues
CIP body is bounded and avoids the historical repeated attribute-1 count=80 pattern
Session handle field is a placeholder for negotiated runtime substitution
issue_safety_notes: This is a structural analogue only: it keeps the affected SendRRData and CPF assembly context but reduces the attribute request to a single bounded entry and replaces optional sockaddr bodies with zero-length placeholders, avoiding the exact crash-inducing payload described in the issue.
